in_sanskrit.name: Bhanu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhanu is a Sanskrit word that means 'sun' or 'moon'. It is derived from the root word 'bha' which means 'to shine'. The prefix 'bhan-' in Bhanu means 'shining' or 'bright'. Thus, Bhanu signifies a radiant and powerful being.

in_hindi.name: भानवर
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhanwar is a title given to the head of a Rajput clan or a feudal lord in Rajasthan. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhanu' which means 'sun' or 'moon'. The suffix 'war' is added to denote a ruler or a chief.
